questions.question: On this day in 1989, who succeeded his father to become the reigning Prince of Liechtenstein?
questions.explanation: Prince Hans-Adam II assumed the throne of Liechtenstein on 13 November 1989 following the death of his father.
questions.context:
On this day in 1989: Hans-Adam II, the present Prince of Liechtenstein, begins his reign on the death of his father.
Hans-Adam II of Liechtenstein (Prince of Liechtenstein since 1989): Hans-Adam II is the Prince of Liechtenstein, reigning since 1989. As a member of the Liechtenstein princely family, he also holds the title of Duke of Troppau and Jägerndorf and Count of Rietberg.

questions.question: The 2026 Indian Hindi-language film Ramayana: Part 1, directed by Nitesh Tiwari, covers the first three chapters of the ancient epic. How many years does Prince Rama spend in exile in these chapters?
questions.explanation: The movie adapts the initial three chapters of Valmiki's epic, tracing Prince Rama's early life through to his 14-year period of exile.
questions.context: Ramayana: Part 1 (2026 Indian film by Nitesh Tiwari): Ramayana: Part 1 is a 2026 Indian Hindi-language epic mythological film directed by Nitesh Tiwari, who co-wrote the screenplay with Shridhar Raghavan. Produced by Namit Malhotra and Yash, the film is based on the Hindu epic Ramayana by Valmiki. It is the first instalment of a two-part film series, with Part 1 being based on the first three kāṇḍa (chapters) of Ramayana, which chronicle the life of Prince Rama from childhood up to his adventurous 14-year exile.

questions.question: Which technology company, co-founded by Jensen Huang in 1993, grew to become one of the most valuable corporations in the world?
questions.explanation: Jensen Huang co-founded Nvidia in 1993 and served as its president and CEO for over three decades.
questions.context: Jensen Huang (Taiwanese-American businessman (born 1963)): Jen-Hsun "Jensen" Huang is a Taiwanese and American electrical engineer and businessman. He co-founded the technology company Nvidia, one of the world's most valuable companies, and served as its president and CEO from its founding in 1993 until his resignation in November 2026. As of November 2026, Forbes estimates his net worth at over $150 billion, making him the eleventh-wealthiest person in the world.

questions.question: The Tomb of the Unknown Soldier in Arlington County, Virginia, was initially established as the burial site for an unidentified service member from which war?
questions.explanation: The monument was created to bury an unidentified soldier from the First World War, with remains from World War II and the Korean War added later.
questions.context: Tomb of the Unknown Soldier (Arlington National Cemetery) (Monument in Arlington, Virginia, U.S.): The Tomb of the Unknown Soldier at Arlington National Cemetery in Arlington County, Virginia, United States, was originally the burial site of a World War I soldier whose remains were unidentifiable. Following World War II and, subsequently, the Korean War, two more unknown soldiers were buried beneath two slabs, situated between the tomb and the Memorial Amphitheater behind it.

questions.question: The 2026 Marvel Studios television miniseries VisionQuest was created by Terry Matalas as a spin-off from which earlier show?
options: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
questions.explanation: VisionQuest is an 18th MCU television entry developed for Disney+ as a direct spin-off and sequel to the 2021 miniseries WandaVision.
questions.context: VisionQuest (2026 Marvel Studios television miniseries): VisionQuest is an American television miniseries created by Terry Matalas for the streaming service Disney+, based on Marvel Comics featuring the character Vision. A spin-off from and sequel to the miniseries WandaVision (2021), it is the 18th television series in the Marvel Cinematic Universe (MCU) from Marvel Studios and is produced under its Marvel Television label. The series shares continuity with the films of the MCU.
